as_built_flow_state.first_major_break: After product creation, the UI does not expose DeepSeek enrichment and no single backend orchestration endpoint continues the flow.
as_built_flow_state.terminal_break: Export to P/GMC/SEO is only registered as workflow metadata; no K export endpoint or runtime dispatch exists.

step_results.as_built: Frontend ProductForm posts to /k/products and backend persists KProductKnowledgeProduct with basic fields.
breaks_or_gaps: Created product is not automatically enriched.

step_results.as_built: Backend has DeepSeek enrichment, translation, risk-filter, and selling-points provider endpoints. Product UI only exposes selling-points generation.
breaks_or_gaps: No DeepSeek enrichment button or flow state in UI.
DeepSeek output is stored but not applied to canonical fields.
Selling points are returned to local component state, not persisted.

step_results.as_built: SERP search can perform a provider HTTP call and store a research run summary. The separate keyword research start endpoint only queues a row.
breaks_or_gaps: SERP returned keywords are not saved to keyword table.
SERP UI is not connected to selected product state.

step_results.as_built: Risk terms can be manually managed in UI and AI risk-filter can create candidate risk terms in backend.
breaks_or_gaps: AI risk-filter endpoint has no UI trigger.
Risk resolve/ignore is not bound to product approval/export gating.
No approval record is required even though adapter metadata marks risk filtering as approval-required.

step_results.as_built: Products, keywords, risks, AI events, translations, media metadata, and research runs are persisted where called.
breaks_or_gaps: Persistence is fragmented by endpoint, not by a complete business transaction.
AI/SERP outputs are not consistently transformed into canonical records.
Operation logs and version rows are not written by current K service paths.

step_results.as_built: Workflow registry contains active metadata for K to P-series, GMC, and SEO. No K export endpoint, UI action, or runtime dispatch was found.
breaks_or_gaps: No handoff is initiated after risk review.
No P/GMC/SEO output preview or download exists.

business_flow_blocking_breakpoints.reason: The backend endpoint exists, but the UI and orchestrated flow do not call it.
DeepSeek output remains JSON payload/event data and is not merged into product knowledge fields.
SERP output keywords are returned and stored in research summary but not inserted into keyword records.
Risk confirmation is not enforced before downstream output.
Only workflow metadata exists; no export action dispatches or produces P/GMC/SEO output.
